card-01.name: King of Swords
card-01.Scene: A crowned king in armour sits on a throne before a golden damask background. He wears a black brimmed hat over his crown and holds a large drawn sword diagonally across his body. Red and gold armour with elaborate tooling. A shield leans against the throne at lower right.

card-03.name: Queen of Swords
card-03.Scene: A crowned queen in a richly decorated dark green and gold gown is seated on a throne. She holds what appears to be a sword in her left hand and a small object in her right. A shield bearing an eagle emblem stands behind her at upper right. Her curled hair flows below the crown.

card-05.name: Cavalier of Swords
card-05.Scene: An armoured knight on horseback charges to the right. He raises a sword overhead in his right hand while his left holds a shield. A defeated figure — crouching or fallen — lies beneath the horse's hooves. The gold damask background fills the upper portion of the card.

card-07.name: King of Batons
card-07.Scene: A long-bearded elder in a richly decorated green and red robe sits at lower left, facing right. He holds a round lantern-like object in each hand. The scale is intimate, the figure occupying the lower third against an elaborate gold-leaf background.

card-09.name: Cavalier of Batons
card-09.Scene: A knight in full plate armour rides a white horse to the left. He wears a plumed helmet and carries a tall baton or staff upright in his right hand. The horse's red bridle is decorated with gold roundels; a dark shield is strapped to the rider's back.

card-11.name: Jack of Batons
card-11.Scene: A standing youth in blue armour holds a tall baton upright in his right hand and faces slightly left. His stance is upright and frontal against a gold damask background. A dark shape — possibly a shield or bag — is partially visible at lower left.

card-13.name: King of Coins
card-13.Scene: A bearded elder in a crown and richly layered robes sits on a throne. His robes are red and blue with gold details; he holds a large ornamental coin or disk in his left hand, and his right hand rests across his chest. The expression is dignified and authoritative.

card-15.name: Queen of Cups
card-15.Scene: A crowned woman in a blue and green gown is seated on a throne. She holds a large, ornate golden chalice in her left hand and a sceptre in her right. The cup is elaborate and cup-shaped, the focal object of the card.

card-17.name: Il Bagatto (The Magician)
card-17.Scene: A plumed-hat merchant or conjurer stands at a table on which several objects — cups, coins, and small tools — are arranged. Two smaller figures, one on each side, attend him. The main figure bends over the table in the classic Bagatto pose.

card-19.name: Il Papa (The Pope)
card-19.Scene: An enthroned bearded elder in white and red papal robes and a triple tiara raises his right hand in blessing. He carries a crozier or cross-staff. The gilded background and authoritative pose identify him clearly as Il Papa.

card-21.name: Temperance
card-21.Scene: A winged seated figure — possibly an angel — pours liquid from one vessel to another held close to the body. The figure is crowned and wears a blue gown; the act of pouring is shown mid-motion.

card-23.name: The Star
card-23.Scene: Two standing figures in courtly dress face each other beneath a large, prominent eight-pointed gold star against a dark blue-grey sky. The star dominates the upper portion of the card; the figures below appear to gesture toward it or toward each other.

card-25.name: The Moon
card-25.Scene: An elderly robed man sits in a chamber beside a spinning wheel or armillary sphere-like device. A crescent moon is visible above in a darkened sky. The man appears to write, calculate, or contemplate while the moon arcs overhead.

card-27.name: The Sun
card-27.Scene: A radiant human-faced sun shines at the top. Below, two figures — a kneeling elder and a standing youth — face each other before an arched architectural portal. The scene suggests a revelation or transmission occurring under the sun's beneficent light.

card-29.name: The World
card-29.Scene: A winged putto or small angel sits atop a large oval wreath of green laurel. Within the wreath, a detailed cityscape is depicted — towers, buildings, water, and perhaps distant hills. Below the wreath, a bird with spread wings (eagle or pelican) faces upward.

card-31.name: Il Matto (The Fool)
card-31.Scene: A barefoot, near-naked figure in a colourful patchwork costume stands centrally, with a folded cloth or hood visible above his head. Two smaller attendant figures flank him — one appears to nip at his coat or legs. The fool is shown in an animated, comic posture.

axis-trumps.name: Surviving Trumps (8)
axis-trumps.Scene: Eight surviving trump cards from the Este Tarot, a set of hand-painted cards produced c. 1450 for the Este court in Ferrara. The surviving trumps are: Il Bagatto, Il Papa, Temperance, The Star, The Moon, The Sun, The World, and Il Matto. The cards are painted on heavy vellum with tempera, gold leaf, and fine brushwork.

axis-courts.name: Surviving Court Cards (8)
axis-courts.Scene: Eight surviving court cards from the Este Tarot: King and Queen of Swords, Cavalier of Swords, King of Batons, Cavalier of Batons, Jack of Batons, King of Coins, and Queen of Cups. Each card depicts a courtly figure in the dress and style of the mid-15th century North Italian court.
